name: Button

props.name: dangerDescription
props.description: Specify the message read by screen readers for the danger button variants

props.name: hasIconOnly
props.description: Specify if the button is an icon-only button

props.name: href
props.description: Optionally specify an href for your Button to become an `<a>` element

props.name: iconDescription
props.description: If specifying the `renderIcon` prop, provide a description for that icon that can be read by screen readers

props.name: isExpressive
props.description: Specify whether the Button is expressive, or not. Only applies to the large/default button size.

props.name: isSelected
props.description: Specify whether the Button is currently selected. Only applies to the icon only Ghost variant.

props.name: kind
props.description: Specify the kind of Button you want to create

props.name: rel
props.description: Optionally specify a `rel` when using an `<a>` element.

props.name: renderIcon
props.description: A component used to render an icon.

props.name: size
props.description: Specify the size of the button, from the following list of sizes:

props.name: target
props.description: Optionally specify a `target` when using an `<a>` element.

props.name: tooltipAlignment
props.description: Specify the alignment of the tooltip to the icon-only button. Can be one of: `start`, `center`, or `end`.

props.name: tooltipDropShadow
props.description: Enable drop shadow for tooltips for icon-only buttons.

props.name: tooltipHighContrast
props.description: Enable high-contrast theme for tooltips on icon-only buttons. Defaults to true.

props.name: tooltipPosition
props.description: Specify the direction of the tooltip for icon-only buttons. Can be either `top`, `right`, `bottom`, or `left`.

a11y.note: Carbon ships a11y behaviour per component; verify per screen

when_to_use: Use Carbon Button rather than building one.
when_not_to_use: Do not restyle off-token — propose a token instead.
